import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path('/workspace/scratch/17aab8431d78/lean-categories-fresh-trials-b')
overlay = Path('/tmp/fresh-math-b-overlay')
base = Path('/tmp/reader-lean-path').read_text().strip()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['LEAN_PATH'] = str(overlay) + ':' + base
for source in sys.argv[1:]:
    rel = Path(source)
    out = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fresh-math-b-build-')) / rel.with_suffix('.olean').name
    result = subprocess.run([
        '/workspace/scratch/17aab8431d78/toolchain-download/lean-4.33.0-linux/bin/lean',
        '-j1', *(['--profile'] if env.get('FRESH_MATH_B_PROFILE') else []),
        '-o', str(out), str(rel)
    ], cwd=root, env=env)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    target = overlay / rel.with_suffix('')
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for suffix in ['.olean', '.olean.private', '.olean.server', '.ir', '.ir.sig']:
        src = out.with_suffix('') .with_name(out.stem + suffix)
        dst = target.with_name(target.name + suffix)
        if not src.exists():
            raise RuntimeError('Missing private compilation artifact: ' + str(src))
        if dst.exists() or dst.is_symlink():
            dst.unlink()
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    print('PRIVATE COMPILE OK: ' + source, flush=True)
